title: SendRRData explicit request for Remove_Member coverage
purpose: Exercise the SendRRData plus CPF plus Message Router parsing path with a minimally structured unconnected explicit request using the plan's named CIP operation as the service byte.
expected_behavior: Parser should accept the EtherNet/IP encapsulation header and Common Packet Format structure as well formed and route the embedded explicit request for normal service handling or a protocol-level service/path status response.
constraints_preserved: Used documented EtherNet/IP command 0x006f for SendRRData in little-endian.
Used documented 24-byte encapsulation header with length field set to 0x0014 for the 20-byte payload.
Used documented common SendRRData item combination: Null Address Item followed by Unconnected Data Item.
CPF item lengths are internally consistent: null item length 0 and unconnected item length 8.
Embedded CIP request uses service byte 0x09 as an inferred mapping for Remove_Member from plan context; this byte-value association was not verified in supplied sources.
Embedded CIP path uses 0x20 class and 0x24 instance logical segments as conservative CIP prior; segment encoding details were not explicitly verified in supplied sources.
Session handle left at zero as a conservative request seed because no supplied source defined a mandatory prior RegisterSession sequence for this corpus entry.
issue_safety_notes: Seed is intended for normal parser coverage only and does not assert any vulnerability behavior.
